about: The sample for the semantic check (system/rag/semcheck.py). Drawn once; do not edit by hand.

rule.pdf: Per document: a random 10% of its pages, at least 3 (all when shorter) = base. Then every other page with a table section (table) and a random half of the other pages with figures only (figure), but the figure pages only when the total stays within 1500 pages. Base and table pages always stay.
rule.web: Every web page in scope, every part.
rule.legislation: About 300 provisions over all laws in scope, in proportion to each law's provisions, at least 2 per law. A provision is a section directly under a Part, Chapter, cross-heading or Schedule (or at the top) whose id is an element id in the XML.

changes.what: English only (ADR 0012, S130): 20 versions in other languages removed; the English awaab-tenants guide (HTML, all parts) added
S133: English originals INDG410, INDG450, CIS26, CIS59 drawn (own random streams); nothing else redrawn
